cost.a: Playin' yer own shanties be free an' always will be; chargin' ye t' listen t' files ye own would be absurd. Th' software be AGPL-3.0 an' all o' it be on GitHub. A paid tier may arrive later fer extras built on top, an' self-hostin' will stay complete rather than becomin' a crippled community edition.

formats.a: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3, AAC, Ogg an' Opus. Dolby Atmos an' other spatial mixes pass through untouched, because re-encodin' somethin' we cannot improve helps nobody.

offline.a: Aye. Plunder an treasure an' it plays wi' no signal an' no server. Th' files live on th' device, not in a stream ye have t' keep alive.

privacy.a: Yer audio ne'er reaches our servers, not even as a cache. Yer phone talks straight t' yer hoard o'er an encrypted connection. We hold yer account, yer hearties list an' yer play history, an' ye can export or scuttle all o' it whenever ye like.

server.a: Yer files need somewhere t' live: an old laptop, a NAS, a Raspberry Pi, or a cheap VPS. Th' hoard server runs on all o' 'em. Point it at a folder an' it takes it from thar.

spotify.a: Not quite. Chordia plays th' shanties ye already have rather than a catalog ye rent. Bring th' treasures ye bought, yer Bandcamp booty, yer Qobuz purchases. If a folder o' files be yer idea o' a record collection, ye be in th' right place.

everywhere.body: Chordia runs in th' browser on any machine ye sign in on, an' installs t' yer port screen on a phone. Gapless playback, crossfade an' an equalizer that remembers what ye did t' it.

points.a: Pick up on yer phone exactly where th' desktop left off.
points.b: Plunder an treasure fer th' flight an' play it wi' no signal.
points.c: Volume levelled across treasures so nothin' blows yer ears off.

everywhere.title: Everywhere ye sign in

features.heading: What ye get

quality.body: Original quality be a byte-fer-byte stream wi' no transcode step an' no silent downgrade. On a train wi' two bars Chordia steps down t' protect yer data, tells ye it has, an' steps back up when th' signal returns.

points.a: FLAC, ALAC an' WAV streamed exactly as they be on disk.
points.b: Atmos an' other spatial mixes pass through untouched.
points.c: Ye decide whether it's e'er allowed t' drop quality.

quality.title: Full quality, or nothin' quietly changed

sharing.body: Split yer collection into as many hoards as ye like, then hand each one t' exactly th' hearties ye choose. They browse an' stream it like it were always theirs. Ye can see what they played, an' ye can take it back in one click.

points.b: Hearties stream from yer server without an account on it.

sharing.title: Divvy up a shelf, not th' whole collection

features.subheading: Four things that be hard t' get anywhere else, in plain language.

yours.body: Chordia ne'er uploads yer hoard, ne'er re-encodes it behind yer back, an' ne'er holds it hostage. Yer hoard server hands audio straight t' yer devices. We only e'er handle th' metadata needed t' sign ye in an' keep yer hearties list straight.

points.a: Audio goes device t' hoard, ne'er through us.
points.b: Belay usin' Chordia an' every file be where ye left it.
points.c: AGPL-3.0. Th' code we run be th' code ye get.

yours.title: Yer files stay yer files

final.body: Make an account, point Chordia at yer shanties, an' have it on yer phone afore th' kettle boils.
final.title: Bring yer shanties wi' ye

footer.rights: Chordia be free software, released under th' AGPL-3.0.
footer.tagline: Shanties ye own, everywhere ye be.

hero.subtitle: Chordia streams th' shanties ye already own. Th' treasures ye bought, th' Bandcamp booty, th' folder ye have dragged across three laptops. It goes from wherever ye keep it straight t' yer devices, at full quality, an' none o' it passes through us.
hero.title: Yer hoard, on every device ye own

selfHost.body: Chordia be two pieces. A Hub holds accounts, hearties an' history. A hoard server holds yer shanties an' streams it. Use our Hub an' run yer own hoard, or run both yerself an' ne'er talk t' us at all.
selfHost.eyebrow: Fer th' scallywags who read th' source first

install.body: One binary or one container. It's happy on a Raspberry Pi, an old NUC, a Synology box or th' cheapest VPS ye can spy.
install.title: Install th' hoard server

pair.body: One step in th' browser. Yer hoard advertises its certificate fingerprint, yer devices pin it, an' self-signed certificates belay bein' a problem.
pair.title: Pair it t' yer account

scan.body: Give it a folder. It reads tags, fetches artwork, an' matches releases against MusicBrainz, includin' th' files whose tags be a mess.
scan.title: Point it at yer shanties

selfHost.title: Or run th' whole thing yerself

social.body: Every play be recorded against yer account, not against a server. Move house, replace th' NAS, rebuild from nothin', an' 2019 be still thar.

points.a: Rotation every week, not once a year as a marketin' stunt.
points.b: First-listen dates, streaks, an' th' treasure ye played 47 times in March.
points.c: Scrobbles t' Last.fm as well, if that be where yer history already lives.
